adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`, which becomes a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`, dropping all collected `teamDestinationCalendars` silently. This is directly verifiable from the diff and is a correctness/data-loss issue for that edge case.
